boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Oregon State University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Corvallis food stops with publicly posted evening hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 4825 SW Research Way, Corvallis
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a food option after most evening dining has ended; check the posted day-specific schedule before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru option with the latest verified hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 3:00 AM Sunday through Thursday and 4:00 AM Friday and Saturday at 4825 SW Research Way.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 4825 SW Research Way, Corvallis
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are posted as 7:00 AM–3:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 7:00 AM–4:00 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut
cards.subtitle: 700 NE Circle Blvd, Corvallis
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order for an evening pizza run; the official location page posts midnight carryout hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Carryout and delivery pizza with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists carryout hours until 11:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and midnight Friday and Saturday at 700 NE Circle Blvd.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut Takeout — 700 NE Circle Blvd, Corvallis
cards.access_notes: Posted carryout hours are 10:30 AM–11:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 AM–12:00 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Pacific Hwy & Circle
cards.subtitle: 350 NE Circle Blvd, Corvallis
cards.notes: Plan this stop for Monday through Saturday evenings, using the drive-thru if you arrive after the dining room’s posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Monday–Saturday drive-thru option until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists this Corvallis location’s drive-thru open until 10:00 PM Monday through Saturday; it is closed Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The posted drive-thru schedule is 6:30 AM–10:00 PM Monday–Saturday; dine-in and carryout end at 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Castor Kitchen & Bar
cards.subtitle: 458 SW Madison Ave, Corvallis
cards.notes: For a later sit-down meal downtown, use the restaurant’s published dinner schedule and confirm seating availability directly before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Downtown dinner service with a posted 9 PM close and later Recess hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Castor lists dinner until 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday and Recess service until 10:00 PM on listed days.
cards.access_notes: The official site posts Recess until 10:00 PM Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday–Saturday after dinner; dinner runs until 9:00 PM Monday–Saturday.

cards.title: American Dream Pizza — Campus
cards.subtitle: 2525 NW Monroe Ave, Corvallis
cards.notes: Use the campus-area location for dine-in, takeout, or delivery; its posted schedule keeps food service available later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A campus-area pizza stop open until 11 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: American Dream Pizza’s official menu lists its Campus location open until 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 PM Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: American Dream Pizza Corvallis menu and hours
cards.access_notes: Campus hours are posted as open daily from 11:00 AM, closing 10:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 PM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: American Dream Pizza — Downtown
cards.subtitle: 214 SW 2nd St, Corvallis
cards.notes: Order food at the downtown location when its late-week schedule fits; use the venue’s current ordering page to confirm service before your trip.
cards.short_summary: Downtown pizza with an official ordering page showing 11 PM Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: American Dream Pizza Downtown’s official ordering page lists food ordering until 11:00 PM Friday and Saturday, 9:45 PM Thursday, and 8:45 PM Sunday through Wednesday.
cards.source_title: American Dream Pizza Downtown — order online
cards.access_notes: Official ordering hours list Friday and Saturday service through 11:00 PM; hours vary the rest of the week.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on NW 9th
cards.subtitle: 1420 NW 9th St, Corvallis
cards.notes: Choose carryout or delivery from the NW 9th Street location when you need an orderable option around midnight; check the live store page first.
cards.short_summary: Pizza delivery and carryout with a verified midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location materials list the 1420 NW 9th Street Corvallis store open until 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Domino’s location materials list this store open until 12:00 AM; store hours can vary, so verify the live listing before ordering.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on NW Monroe
cards.subtitle: 2455 NW Monroe Ave, Corvallis
cards.notes: Use the Monroe Avenue store for delivery or carryout when its later posted closing time works for your evening; confirm the current store schedule online.
cards.short_summary: A second Corvallis Domino’s location listed until 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location materials list the 2455 NW Monroe Avenue Corvallis store open until 1:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Domino’s Corvallis location materials identify the Monroe Avenue store as open until 1:00 AM; confirm live ordering availability before leaving.

cards.title: del Alma
cards.subtitle: 136 SW Washington Ave, Corvallis
cards.notes: Book or walk in for a downtown dinner on a night when the posted 9:30 PM Friday–Saturday close suits your plans; reservations are encouraged.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant serving dinner later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: del Alma lists dinner from 5:00 PM to 9:30 PM Friday and Saturday and until 9:00 PM Tuesday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Dinner hours are posted as 5:00–9:00 PM Tuesday–Thursday and 5:00–9:30 PM Friday–Saturday; the restaurant says reservations are encouraged.

cards.title: Five Guys
cards.subtitle: 845 NW 9th St, Corvallis
cards.notes: Use this NW 9th Street stop for an evening burger, fries, or shake; check the location page for that day’s closing time and available service.
cards.short_summary: A Corvallis burger and shake stop that posts a 10 PM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Guys’ official Corvallis location page lists the restaurant at 845 NW 9th Street as closing at 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: The official location page states that the Corvallis store closes at 10:00 PM; verify the day’s hours before traveling.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten specific Oregon State destinations for gathering, studying, campus resources, and recreation.

cards.title: Memorial Union
cards.subtitle: Central campus gathering spaces and student services
cards.notes: Use the floor plan to find the Main Lounge, Creative Studio, Lanes & Games, meeting rooms, and student-facing offices before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub with informal gathering areas, services, and program spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the Memorial Union as a campus hub with formal and informal gathering spaces; it houses student services, Lanes & Games, the Creative Studio, restaurants, and lounges.
cards.access_notes: Use the Memorial Union’s posted building information and floor plan; individual rooms and services may have separate access rules.

cards.title: Memorial Union Quad
cards.subtitle: Open lawn between the Memorial Union and Milam Hall
cards.notes: Pause on the lawn between classes, then check the university events calendar for programs scheduled in the quad.
cards.short_summary: A central open-air campus space used for university and student-organization events.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU identifies the MU Quad as a large open space between the Memorial Union and Milam Hall; student organizations and departments may reserve it.
cards.access_notes: The quad is outdoors. Events and reserved uses can affect available space.

cards.title: Student Experience Center Plaza
cards.subtitle: Covered outdoor space between the SEC and Memorial Union
cards.notes: Use this rain-protected plaza as a meeting point along Jefferson Way, and look for student and university events on the calendar.
cards.short_summary: A covered open-air plaza connecting two major student buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the Student Experience Center Plaza as a covered, open-air event space between the Student Experience Center and Memorial Union.
cards.access_notes: The plaza is available to the campus community; reservations may affect use.

cards.title: Valley Library Rotunda
cards.subtitle: The Valley Library’s prominent central study area
cards.notes: Enter the rotunda and check the second, fourth, and fifth-floor nooks for a one-person seat or room for a study partner.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable library study area with smaller seating nooks on upper floors.
cards.evidence_claim: An OSU student-life feature identifies the Valley Library rotunda and its second-, fourth-, and fifth-floor nooks as places to study alone or with a partner.
cards.access_notes: Follow current Valley Library building hours and any posted space-use guidance.

cards.title: Valley Library Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Flexible study area in the Valley Library
cards.notes: Bring a group project or solo task and use the commons’ study seating, desktop computers, scanners, printers, and power-ready setup.
cards.short_summary: A refreshed library area for individual and group work with technology nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU states that the Learning Commons offers individual and group study areas, desktop computers, scanners, and printers; its 2025 refresh was guided by student feedback.
cards.source_title: Popular library study area gets a refresh
cards.access_notes: Use during current Valley Library hours; equipment and seating are subject to availability.

cards.title: Collaborative Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons support hub in the Valley Library
cards.notes: Pair study time with scheduled help from the Career, Chemistry, Library, Math, Physics, or Writing Center services listed for the CLC.
cards.short_summary: A library-based learning-support location connecting students with several academic services.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says the Collaborative Learning Center, located in the Learning Commons, offers scheduled assistance from Career, Chemistry, Library, Math, Physics, and Writing Center services.
cards.access_notes: Support is offered during scheduled hours; confirm the relevant service’s current availability before visiting.

cards.title: International Living-Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Study seating near Cascadia Café and Market
cards.notes: Choose this space when you want an active shared atmosphere, then keep food and drink plans separate from study-space expectations.
cards.short_summary: A living-learning building with a social study atmosphere and nearby food options.
cards.evidence_claim: An OSU student-life feature recommends the International Living-Learning Center for studying amid ambient activity and notes nearby Cascadia Café and Market.
cards.access_notes: Observe building signage and current access guidance; café and market purchases are separate.

cards.title: Learning Innovation Center Upper Floors
cards.subtitle: Upper-floor seating with a valley-facing view
cards.notes: Take the elevator or stairs to upper floors and look for open seating when you want to read or work with a view toward Marys Peak.
cards.short_summary: An academic building with upper-floor spots suited to focused reading and project work.
cards.evidence_claim: An OSU student-life feature highlights upper floors of the Learning Innovation Center, including fifth-floor seating with views toward Marys Peak, for reading and projects.
cards.access_notes: Use open seating only and respect classes, events, and posted building access rules.

cards.title: Asian & Pacific Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: 2695 SW Jefferson Way
cards.notes: Visit the lounge or study space, explore the center’s library and resources, and check its programming for ways to connect with the community.
cards.short_summary: A cultural center with lounge, study, quiet-room, kitchen, and library resources.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says the Asian & Pacific Cultural Center offers a lounge, study space, quiet room, kitchen, computers, library, and engagement opportunities; its resources are open to the OSU community.
cards.access_notes: The center lists resources for students, faculty, staff, and the OSU community; confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Dixon Indoor Climbing Center
cards.subtitle: Inside Dixon Recreation Center
cards.notes: Check current Rec Sports entry requirements, then use the climbing center’s redesigned wall, bouldering area, and accessible belay ledge responsibly.
cards.short_summary: A renovated campus climbing facility within Dixon Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU reports that Dixon’s Indoor Climbing Center is open and includes a modern climbing surface, a Kilter Board, and an accessible belay ledge.
cards.access_notes: Rec Sports facility access and participation requirements apply; check current policies and hours before arriving.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost ways to spend time on or near Oregon State University’s Corvallis campus.

cards.title: Browse Fairbanks Gallery
cards.subtitle: Fairbanks Hall, OSU Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Drop in during the listed weekday hours to look through the current exhibition; check the academic calendar for holiday and term-break closures.
cards.short_summary: A public campus gallery with rotating art displays.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists Fairbanks Gallery hours as Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., and states that it is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Weekday hours are listed as 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; OSU notes holiday and term-break closures.

cards.title: Take the OSU self-guided tour
cards.subtitle: Oregon State University Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Use OSU’s free tour app to choose a route and explore campus at your own pace, following audio stops from student TOUR Ambassadors.
cards.short_summary: A phone-guided campus walk with student-recorded stops.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says its self-guided tour app is free and can be used on campus for a guided tour experience.
cards.access_notes: Self-guided; use the app and follow normal campus access guidance.

cards.title: Follow the public-art tour
cards.subtitle: OSU Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Download PRAxTours, then make a walk of the campus collection by selecting nearby outdoor works and galleries from the self-guided tour.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided route through OSU’s permanent public art.
cards.evidence_claim: PRAx states that PRAxTours offers self-guided tours of campus public art, galleries, and the visual and performing arts center.
cards.source_title: Public Art | PRAx | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: Self-guided via the PRAxTours mobile app; outdoor works can be viewed while campus areas are accessible.

cards.title: Meet on the MU Quad
cards.subtitle: 2501 SW Jefferson Way, Corvallis
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or a Frisbee and use the open lawn between the Memorial Union and Milam Hall for a low-key outdoor meetup.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lawn for casual outdoor time.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU identifies the Memorial Union Quad as a large open space between the Memorial Union and Milam Hall; OSU also states that Frisbees, yard games, and picnics are welcome on campus lawns.
cards.source_title: How to get the most out of OSU green spaces
cards.access_notes: Campus is open to the public; avoid reserved areas or events and follow posted site guidance.

cards.entity_name: Oak Creek Center for Urban Horticulture
cards.title: Walk Oak Creek’s gardens
cards.subtitle: 844 SW 35th St., Corvallis
cards.notes: Take a daylight loop through the horticulture center and slow down around the habitat plantings; use the walk-around gate access if it is closed.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge garden and wildlife habitat open daily.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Extension states that the Oak Creek Center for Urban Horticulture is open to the public from dawn to dusk and visitors may walk around a closed gate.
cards.source_title: Oak Creek Center for Urban Horticulture designated a Certified Wildlife Habitat
cards.access_notes: Open to the public dawn to dusk; the source says visitors may walk around a closed gate.

cards.title: Walk the Avery Park loop
cards.subtitle: Avery Park and Natural Area, 1200 SW Avery Park Dr.
cards.notes: Use the one-mile walking and jogging trail for a conversation-paced lap, then pause by the Marys River riparian area before heading back.
cards.short_summary: A one-mile park loop alongside the Marys River.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Corvallis describes a one-mile walking/jogging trail through Avery Park and along the Marys River riparian area.
cards.source_title: Avery Park and Natural Area | Corvallis Oregon
cards.access_notes: Use public park paths; picnic shelters may be reserved for private events, so do not use a reserved shelter.

cards.title: Wander the Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Avery Park and Natural Area, near the northwest entrance
cards.notes: Walk the garden’s paths and benches during the May–October bloom season; leave every bloom and fallen petal in place for other visitors.
cards.short_summary: A public rose garden with arbors, benches, art, and paths.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the Rose Garden has benches, arbors, art, and trails, and its rules apply to both renters and the general public.
cards.access_notes: General-public access is described; do not clip or collect roses or petals, and yield to permitted private events.

cards.title: Hike Chip Ross
cards.subtitle: Chip Ross Park and Natural Area, Lester Avenue access
cards.notes: Start at the Lester Avenue trailhead and take the easy-to-moderate 1.5-mile loop; bring water and stay on the established trail.
cards.short_summary: A short oak-woodland hike with hilltop views.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Corvallis describes an easy-to-moderate 1.5-mile hiking trail at Chip Ross Natural Area and identifies Lester Avenue parking access.
cards.source_title: Chip Ross Park and Natural Area | Corvallis Oregon
cards.access_notes: Access is at the end of Lester Avenue; use designated trails and observe posted seasonal trail rules.

cards.entity_name: Forest Discovery Trail at Peavy Arboretum
cards.title: Explore Peavy’s Forest Discovery Trail
cards.subtitle: Peavy Arboretum, 7 miles north of Corvallis
cards.notes: Pick up the self-guided materials and follow the 1.2-mile forest hike from Arboretum Parking, using the prompts to notice ecology and history.
cards.short_summary: A guided, hands-on forest walk at Peavy Arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU’s Forest Discovery Trail guide states that the program is free to use for OSU Research Forest visitors and takes place at Peavy Arboretum.
cards.source_title: Forest Discovery Trail Program Teacher’s Guide
cards.access_notes: The trail begins from Arboretum Parking; plan for a 1.2-mile outdoor hike and check local conditions before leaving.

cards.title: Take a downtown Central Park break
cards.subtitle: 650 NW Monroe Ave., Corvallis
cards.notes: Use the paved walkways, benches, playground, and sculpture stops for a relaxed downtown reset; leave dogs at home because they are not allowed here.
cards.short_summary: A downtown park with walkways, public art, benches, and a playground.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Corvallis describes Central Park as a public downtown park with paved walkways, sculptures, resting benches, and a playground.
cards.access_notes: City page lists the park at 650 NW Monroe Avenue and says dogs are not allowed.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented OSU study environments in Corvallis, spanning library nooks, lounges, cultural centers, and academic buildings.

cards.title: Valley Library Rotunda
cards.subtitle: Valley Library · Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Choose a rotunda nook on the second, fourth, or fifth floor for a compact solo setup; some nooks seat one person or a pair.
cards.short_summary: Multi-floor rotunda nooks provide small-scale seating inside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU identifies seating nooks beside the Valley Library rotunda on the second, fourth, and fifth floors.
cards.access_notes: Use library access rules and current building hours; individual seating is not reservable.

cards.title: Memorial Union Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union · Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Set up at the large tables in the Memorial Union’s main-floor student lounge; move to the porch only when outdoor conditions suit.
cards.short_summary: A main-floor lounge with large tables and nearby JavaStop service.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the Memorial Union’s main-floor student lounge as having large tables and notes JavaStop and its porch nearby.
cards.access_notes: Use current Memorial Union building access information; café purchases are optional and separate.

cards.title: Peavy Hall Upper-Floor Seating
cards.subtitle: Peavy Hall · Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Head upstairs for the row of high-backed chairs by floor-to-ceiling windows, then use the natural light for reading or laptop work.
cards.short_summary: High-backed window chairs offer an indoor reading-and-writing setting.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU directs students upstairs in Peavy Hall to high-backed chairs paired with floor-to-ceiling windows.
cards.access_notes: Use current Peavy Hall building access information before planning a session.

cards.title: International Living-Learning Center Common Area
cards.subtitle: International Living-Learning Center · Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Bring work that tolerates ambient conversation and use the ILLC common area; Cascadia Café or Market is nearby if you need a break.
cards.short_summary: A common-area environment suited to work with background activity.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the International Living-Learning Center as a study setting with ambient conversation and Cascadia Café or Market steps away.
cards.access_notes: Use current ILLC building access information; food and drinks require separate purchase.

cards.title: Learning Innovation Center Top-Floor Seating
cards.subtitle: Learning Innovation Center · Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Take readings or a project to the upper floors, and look for a fifth-floor seat facing Marys Peak when one is available.
cards.short_summary: Upper-floor seating pairs project work with broad valley-facing views.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU highlights top-floor Learning Innovation Center study seating, including fifth-floor views toward Marys Peak.
cards.access_notes: Use current Learning Innovation Center building access information; seating is not described as reservable.

cards.title: Austin Hall Fireplace Seating
cards.subtitle: Austin Hall · Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Choose a couch with a fireplace view or a café table by the windows, then keep food and drink purchases separate from your study plan.
cards.short_summary: Fireplace-side couches and window tables provide two work setups in Austin Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU identifies fireplace-view couches and window-side café tables in Austin Hall as study options.
cards.access_notes: Use current Austin Hall building access information; Trader Bing’s purchases are separate.

cards.title: Champinefu Lodge Basic Needs Center
cards.subtitle: Champinefu Lodge · Corvallis campus
cards.notes: If you are an OSU student, use the Basic Needs Center’s fireplace-side seating; its beverage station and microwave support a longer session.
cards.short_summary: A student-accessible center with fireplace seating and basic food-prep amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU states that Champinefu Lodge houses the Basic Needs Center, open to all students, with a fireplace, beverage station, and microwave.
cards.access_notes: Open to OSU students; confirm the Basic Needs Center’s current access information before visiting.

cards.title: Women’s Building Lobby
cards.subtitle: Women’s Building · Corvallis campus
cards.notes: Use the lobby’s high-backed chairs and fireplace for independent work, and bring headphones in case an adjacent gym class is active.
cards.short_summary: A historic lobby workspace with high-backed chairs and a fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the Women’s Building lobby as having wood floors, high-backed chairs, and a fireplace, with occasional adjacent gym classes.
cards.access_notes: Use current Women’s Building access information; noise from the adjacent gym may vary.

cards.entity_name: SLUG Honors College Student Learning Center
cards.title: SLUG Honors College Student Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Learning Innovation Center 340 · Honors College
cards.notes: Honors College students can use the tables, writable surfaces, computers, and lounge; contact the college if a private study room is needed.
cards.short_summary: An Honors College learning center with study tools and a reservable private room.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists computers, free printing, study and lounge space, writable surfaces, and a private study room at the SLUG in LInC 340.
cards.access_notes: The SLUG is the Honors College student learning space; contact Honors College to reserve its study room.

cards.title: Ettihad Cultural Center Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Student Experience Center Suite 380
cards.notes: Use the center’s study or quiet space, then switch to its computers or mini library when your work calls for a different setup.
cards.short_summary: A Student Experience Center cultural-resource space with study and quiet areas.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists study spaces, a quiet space, computers, and a mini library among Ettihad Cultural Center resources.
cards.access_notes: OSU says the center’s space and resources are open to students, faculty, staff, and the wider OSU community.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops along NW Monroe Avenue, the 14th–26th Street corridor that connects Oregon State University with Corvallis businesses.

cards.title: Mediterranean at Crystal's Cuisine & Cafe
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · corner of NW 14th Street
cards.notes: Walk to the NW 14th Street corner and use the café's menu to choose among shawerma, gyros, falafel, and baba ghanouj.
cards.short_summary: A named Mediterranean café at the east end of the Monroe corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Crystal's Cuisine & Cafe identifies its location as the corner of SW Monroe Avenue and NW 14th Street and lists Mediterranean menu items including shawerma, gyros, and falafel.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; check the business directly for current availability.

cards.title: Made-to-Order Crepes at The Naked Crepe
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · Cobblestone Square at NW 14th Street
cards.notes: Stop at the Cobblestone Square storefront when you want a sweet or savory crepe made to order along Monroe Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A crepe storefront at the 14th-and-Monroe end of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Travel Oregon lists The Naked Crepe at 1425 NW Monroe Ave and describes sweet and savory crepes made to order from its 14th-and-Monroe storefront.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; confirm current service details with the business.

cards.title: Hawaiian Plates at Local Boyz
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · Cobblestone Square
cards.notes: Use the 1425 NW Monroe Avenue stop for a meal centered on the café's traditional Hawaiian dishes, including sweet shoyu chicken.
cards.short_summary: A named Hawaiian-food stop in Cobblestone Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Local Boyz Hawaiian Cafe at 1425 NW Monroe Avenue and notes traditional Hawaiian dishes such as sweet shoyu chicken.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; verify current menu and service before going.

cards.title: Thai Chili at Cobblestone Square
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 1425 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Choose this Cobblestone Square stop for Thai food, and plan to bring cash because OSU's dining guide identifies it as cash only.
cards.short_summary: A Thai-food destination with a practical payment note.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Thai Chili at 1425 NW Monroe Avenue and identifies the restaurant as cash only.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; bring cash and verify current service details.

cards.title: Coffee and Wi-Fi at Interzone
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 1563 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Make the short walk west along Monroe for coffee, then use the vegetarian or vegan menu and the shop's listed free Wi-Fi.
cards.short_summary: A coffee-shop stop with vegetarian and vegan food options.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Interzone Coffee Shop at 1563 NW Monroe Avenue with organic coffee, a vegetarian/vegan menu, and free Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Purchases are required for menu items; ask staff about Wi-Fi access and current seating policies.

cards.title: Thai and Pho at Lemongrass
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 1603 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Use this 1603 NW Monroe Avenue destination when you want Thai cuisine or pho, as identified in Oregon State's local dining guide.
cards.short_summary: A named noodle-house stop just west of the 14th Street cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Lemongrass Noodle House at 1603 NW Monroe Avenue and identifies its cuisine as Thai and pho.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; confirm current menu and service before visiting.

cards.title: Rice Bowls at Café Yumm!
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 2001 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Head to the 2001 NW Monroe Avenue location for Asian-inspired rice bowls, wraps, and salads with vegetarian-friendly options.
cards.short_summary: A Monroe Avenue stop for vegetarian-friendly bowls, wraps, and salads.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists Café Yumm! at 2001 NW Monroe Avenue and describes vegetarian-friendly Asian-inspired rice bowls, wraps, and salads.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; verify current menu and service details with the restaurant.

cards.title: Sandwiches at Jersey Mike's
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 2051 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Use the 2051 NW Monroe Avenue storefront for a quick sandwich stop while moving along the corridor beside campus.
cards.short_summary: A named sandwich-shop destination in the middle of the Monroe corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Union's Corvallis location page lists Jersey Mike's Subs at 2051 NW Monroe Ave.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; check the restaurant directly for current menu and service.

cards.title: Pizza at American Dream
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · 2525 NW Monroe Avenue
cards.notes: Continue toward the 26th Street end of Monroe for the campus American Dream Pizza location listed in OSU's nearby-restaurants guide.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza stop near the west end of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State University's College of Science lists American Dream Pizza at 2525 NW Monroe Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Food service requires a purchase; confirm current service and menu details directly.

cards.title: Coffee and Tea at Allan's
cards.subtitle: NW Monroe Avenue corridor · corner of NW 26th Street
cards.notes: Finish at the 26th-and-Monroe corner for a coffee or tea stop directly across from Oregon State University.
cards.short_summary: A long-running café at the west endpoint of the Monroe corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Allan's Coffee & Tea states that its Corvallis café is at 2541 NW Monroe Street, on the corner of Monroe and 26th Street across from Oregon State University.
cards.source_title: Corvallis Campus Remodel — Allan's Coffee & Tea
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require a purchase; check the café directly for current service details.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Oregon State traditions, from the incoming-student procession to recurring campus celebrations and school songs.

cards.title: Spell out the Beavers
cards.subtitle: Football tradition and school song
cards.notes: Listen for the spelled-out “O-S-U” and “B-E-A-V-E-R-S” responses in Oregon State’s official fight-song lyrics.
cards.short_summary: Oregon State’s fight song includes two unmistakable spelled-out calls.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State publishes the OSU Fight Song with the parenthetical calls “LET’S GO O-S-U!” and “OSU Fight! B-E-A-V-E-R-S.”
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: Use the official lyrics page to follow the call-and-response wording.

cards.title: Sing “Hail to Old OSU”
cards.subtitle: Oregon State school song
cards.notes: Compare the official lyrics’ alternative wording, including “each man (one)” and “every man (throughout the land).”
cards.short_summary: A school song credited by Oregon State to Harold A. Wilkins.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State identifies “Hail to Old OSU” as written by Harold A. Wilkins and publishes its lyrics among football traditions and school songs.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: The lyrics are publicly available on Oregon State’s traditions page.

cards.title: Walk from the MU Quad to Gill
cards.subtitle: Fall welcome ceremony for new students
cards.notes: New students line up at the Memorial Union Quad, join the 26th Street processional, then continue to Gill Coliseum.
cards.short_summary: The incoming class is formally welcomed through a campus walk and convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State describes the New Student Walk and Convocation as a major Welcome Week/Connect tradition, with a processional from the MU Quad to Gill Coliseum.
cards.access_notes: The 2025 event listed lineup at the MU Quad, a 26th Street walk, and the Gill Coliseum ceremony.

cards.title: Join the Orange and Black Rally
cards.subtitle: Fall Connect tradition
cards.notes: Check the Fall Connect calendar as it is updated, then use the rally as a straightforward first-week introduction to campus spirit.
cards.short_summary: A named Oregon State fall welcome event centered on the university’s colors.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State’s new-student onboarding page lists the Orange and Black Rally among Fall Connect events that students can look forward to the following year.
cards.source_title: Connect | Office of New Student Onboarding | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: Fall 2026 Connect begins September 16; Oregon State says its event calendar will continue to be updated.

cards.title: Mark the term’s start at Beaver Bash
cards.subtitle: Fall Connect welcome event
cards.notes: Watch the Fall Connect calendar for this named welcome event; Oregon State’s traditions page describes activities and pancakes in the MU Ballroom.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Oregon State welcome-week celebration with programmed activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State lists the End of Summer Beaver Bash in its Fall Connect recap and describes it on its campus traditions page.
cards.source_title: Connect | Office of New Student Onboarding | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: Check the current Fall Connect calendar for the event’s date, location, and participation details.

cards.title: Take the first-day photo
cards.subtitle: Fall Connect photo tradition
cards.notes: Look for the designated First Day of School Pictures activity on the Fall Connect calendar and bring the people you want in the frame.
cards.short_summary: A named first-week photo activity in Oregon State’s new-student sequence.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State’s Office of New Student Onboarding lists First Day of School Pictures among Fall Connect events students can expect the following year.
cards.source_title: Connect | Office of New Student Onboarding | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Fall Connect calendar for time and location details.

cards.title: Meet campus groups at the Beaver Community Fair
cards.subtitle: Fall Connect community event
cards.notes: Use the fair to learn which campus organizations and services are present, and confirm this year’s logistics through the Connect calendar.
cards.short_summary: A named Oregon State welcome event for connecting with the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State lists the Beaver Community Fair among the Fall Connect events students can look forward to in a future fall term.
cards.source_title: Connect | Office of New Student Onboarding | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: The university notes that Fall Connect events and calendar details are added over time.

cards.title: Close the year at DAM JAM
cards.subtitle: Annual student-run music event
cards.notes: Pair the concert with the preceding Jamboree, which Oregon State says includes interactive games, student performances, awards, and prizes.
cards.short_summary: An annual end-of-year music event created for students by students.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State describes DAM JAM as an annual music event put on for students by students, with an annual Jamboree before the concert.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: Confirm each year’s date, venue, and entry information through Oregon State’s current event listings.

cards.title: Experience the Ho'ike
cards.subtitle: Polynesian dance tradition at Oregon State
cards.notes: Attend with attention to the student performers and the event’s Hawaiian student, parent, and alumni support network described by Oregon State.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Oregon State cultural presentation of Polynesian dance.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State calls the Hui o Hawai'i Club Ho'ike a 68-year tradition featuring Polynesian dances performed by Oregon State students.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: Check Oregon State’s current event listings for the next presentation’s date, venue, and admission details.

cards.title: Find the Homecoming tug of war
cards.subtitle: Fall Homecoming tradition
cards.notes: Follow the current Homecoming schedule for the event location and participation rules; Oregon State identifies tug of war as part of its traditional festivities.
cards.short_summary: A named contest within Oregon State’s Homecoming observance.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State says Homecoming includes traditional festivities such as the football game, tug of war, and a student carnival.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: Use the current Oregon State Homecoming schedule rather than relying on past event dates.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Oregon State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A daytime, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence using permanent campus destinations and a nearby OSU research forest.

cards.title: Start at the Memorial Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Use the MU as a first landmark: check the building directory, orient yourself to Jefferson Way, and make a low-pressure plan for the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A central campus hub with services, gathering spaces, and student programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State identifies the Memorial Union as a central hub for students, staff, and faculty at 2501 SW Jefferson Way.
cards.access_notes: Check the Memorial Union website for current building hours before going.

cards.title: Find the Student Experience Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 2251 SW Jefferson Way
cards.notes: Walk through the SEC lobby and note the Info Desk location. It is a practical place to return when you need directions or details about campus activities.
cards.short_summary: A named campus building that hosts student-facing programs and services.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU's events directory lists the Student Experience Center at 2251 SW Jefferson Way and describes an SEC lobby Info Desk for directions and event information.
cards.source_title: Connect Info Desk — Oregon State University
cards.access_notes: The cited Info Desk event was scheduled on a specific date; use the SEC as a navigation stop and verify service availability separately.

cards.title: Settle into Valley Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 201 SW Waldo Place
cards.notes: Take a short reset in a reading area, then identify a group-study option you could use later. Save the library contact details while you are there.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with individual and collaborative study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes Valley Library as offering reading spots, collaborative study rooms, and resources across subjects at 201 SW Waldo Place.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current library entry and service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Add Fairbanks Hall to your art loop
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · 220 SW 26th Street
cards.notes: Find Fairbanks Hall during daylight and look for posted gallery or event information. Treat it as a useful visual landmark near the campus core.
cards.short_summary: A named OSU building that includes Fairbanks Gallery and hosts arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU's events directory lists Fairbanks Hall at 220 SW 26th Street and identifies Fairbanks Gallery within the building.
cards.access_notes: Gallery exhibitions and building access vary; check current listings before planning an indoor visit.

cards.title: Walk by Reser Stadium
cards.subtitle: Friday early evening · 700 SW 26th Street
cards.notes: Use the stadium exterior as a navigation anchor on the west side of campus. Check the official calendar if you want to pair the walk with a public event.
cards.short_summary: A prominent Oregon State athletics venue on SW 26th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU's events directory lists Reser Stadium at 700 SW 26th Street in Corvallis.
cards.access_notes: This card is for an exterior campus walk; stadium interior access depends on scheduled events.

cards.title: Plan a Dixon Rec session
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 425 SW 26th Street
cards.notes: Check the current facility schedule, then choose one available activity such as open recreation or climbing. Bring your OSU ID and follow facility-entry requirements.
cards.short_summary: OSU's recreation center with courts, pools, climbing, studios, and fitness spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists Dixon Recreation Center at 425 SW 26th Street and documents its climbing center, pools, courts, studios, and weight rooms.
cards.access_notes: Current Rec Sports membership is required for facility access; confirm hours and any closures on the official hours page.

cards.title: See Student Legacy Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · recreation area
cards.notes: Walk the park perimeter and locate the fields, tennis complex, and pavilion. If you plan to use a court, review Rec Sports booking and eligibility guidance first.
cards.short_summary: An OSU recreation area with lighted turf fields, tennis courts, and a covered pavilion.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists Student Legacy Park as having turf fields with lighting, a tennis complex, and a covered pavilion.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and court reservations may require current Rec Sports membership; check availability before going.

cards.title: Take a daylight walk at Peavy Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · north of Corvallis
cards.notes: Use the posted directions to reach the arboretum, park only in designated areas, and stay on authorized routes. Check forest updates for closures before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: The gateway to OSU's McDonald-Dunn Research Forest, with a diverse tree collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State identifies Peavy Arboretum as the gateway to the McDonald-Dunn Research Forest and says it showcases diverse tree species.
cards.access_notes: The research forest is a working forest, not a park; follow posted closures and safety guidance.

cards.title: Choose an authorized forest route
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · about 15 minutes north of campus
cards.notes: Pick an authorized trail or road from the official forest map, share your plan with a friend, and leave research sites and markings undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: An 11,500-acre OSU research and demonstration forest open for public recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Oregon State says the combined McDonald-Dunn Research Forest covers 11,500 acres, is about 15 minutes north of campus, and welcomes recreational visitors.
cards.access_notes: Use only authorized roads and trails and check current forest updates. Do not enter closed areas or interfere with research activity.

cards.title: Save MU Lanes & Games for a future game night
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · beneath the MU Commons
cards.notes: Look over the activity options and current status, then plan a visit after reopening. A reservation can help if you want bowling or a table at a set time.
cards.short_summary: A student-run on-campus recreation venue for bowling, billiards, arcade games, Switch, and gaming lounge use.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes MU Lanes & Games as an on-campus student-run recreation facility offering bowling, billiards, arcade games, Nintendo Switch, and a gaming lounge.
cards.access_notes: The official page states that Lanes & Games is closed for summer 2026 renovations and is expected to return in fall 2026; verify reopening and prices first.
